sources.title: Character.AI's Noam Shazeer on what we know about AI—and what we don't
sources.quote_checked: It's more like alchemy or whatever chemistry was in the Middle Ages. | You experiment, and you have intuitions about why you know how something works. | My best guess is divine benevolence. | It's hard. Nobody really understands what's going on. | This is a very experimental science, which nobody's really used to in the world of computing. | You come up with some formulas about what seemed to work well, and try to scale it up.

sources.title: Universally Accessible Intelligence
sources.quote_checked: I don't know that I particularly care about AGI in the sense of wanting something that can do absolutely everything a person can do. | Our goal is to be an AGI company and a product-first company. | It's a cool first use case for AGI.

sources.title: Character.AI CEO Noam Shazeer returns to Google
sources.quote_checked: I am super excited to return to Google and work as part of the Google DeepMind team. | I am so proud of everything we built at Character.AI over the last 3 years.

sources.title: Gemini's co-lead is leaving Google to join OpenAI
sources.quote_checked: excited to share that I'll be joining OpenAI

sources.title: Jeff Dean & Noam Shazeer — 25 years at Google: from PageRank to AGI
sources.by: Dwarkesh Patel with Jeff Dean and Noam Shazeer
sources.quote_checked: My dream is I wake up in the morning, come up with an idea, hack it up in a day. | Mostly these things fail, but if you try 100 things or 1,000 things or a million things. | Everyone seems to want to run their experiment at maximum scale, but I think that's a human problem. | The beautiful thing about model parameters is they are quite memory-efficient at memorizing facts.
